items.information: # 🇺🇾 Límite de competidores: 40. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32184-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32185-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor descalificandolo de la ronda en cuestión, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 40. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32184-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CervantesCubea2023#32185-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, as per regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition's website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 1 guest each. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell. If you need to cancel your registration due to the onset of any COVID-19 symptoms and/or testing positive for COVID-19 (cough, fever, chills, nausea, etc) even on the weekend of the competition, let us, your organisers, know and we will arrange a FULL refund for you.

items.name: Get to Work Chicagoland 2023
items.information: Competitions in highly populated areas - like this one - tend to fill quickly, and do have limited spots. Please [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/register) as soon as you are able, in order to secure a spot in this competition. If you are on the [competitor list](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/registrations) and are no longer planning on competing in this competition, please cancel your registration. There will be competitors on the [waitist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#28080-waitlist) who are wishing to take your place, and you wil recieve a refund if you cancel by the refund deadline. Please review the "[Competitor Responsibilities/Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#28078-competitor-responsibilities-info-must-read)" tab, and other tabs as necessary, before the competition. Please take note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change depending on whether this competition is running ahead of time, or behind on time. We are not responsible for no-shows if we begin an event early, and you miss your opprotunity to compete. We need to keep the competition moving along, so we recommend arriving 20-30 minutes before you are scheduled to compete/judge. We may also change the original schedule after competitors register for the competition based on registration numbers for each event, but we will not add or remove full events or change the order of events. At the end of the competition, please pick up any garbage left over and dispose it. This will allow the opportunity that we can use this venue again for more competitions in the future. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHN0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--50185814dd3aca6d46fbfd751cf63a2aa0a3739b/image.png)

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors to beautiful Taos, NM, for the first competition held in the city! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor! This competition has a 70 competitor limit. Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need.https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:00 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50% refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (8-26-2023) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!
